title: Code and data for "Hardware-aware QAOA for crossing-fibre reconstruction in diffusion MRI"
description:
Code and reproducibility materials for the manuscript "Hardware-aware QAOA for crossing-fibre reconstruction in diffusion MRI" (Nemy and Ferreira). The archive contains the construction of sparse 50-variable Ising graphs from 5 × 5-voxel diffusion-MRI patches, exact MILP solutions, noiseless and matrix-product-state QAOA simulation, the IBM Heron (ibm_aachen) and Nighthawk (ibm_berlin) depth-one QAOA hardware workflows, finite-budget classical controls, non-spatial baselines, statistical analyses and figure scripts, together with the synthetic-phantom numerical results and raw hardware bitstrings.

HCP-YA imaging data are not redistributed; see README.md.
